Subject: QBR & roadmap demo — 2-hour vs. timeboxed 45m options

Hi Ava / Tom,

Thanks again for the renewal conversation last week — excited to pair on the QBR and the roadmap demo for TideCare's expansion. To make scheduling simpler for execs, we wanted to propose two formats and get your preference: 

1) Deep-dive QBR (2 hours): product roadmap, usage & cost trends, open items, and ask/next steps. Best if execs and platform engineers can stay for the whole block.
2) Timeboxed pairing (45 minutes): high-level roadmap + 15m ops/next-steps breakout for CS + Engs. Good when execs prefer shorter, focused sessions.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 17: 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed Nov 18: 10:00–10:45 or 15:00–15:45

I attached a draft QBR agenda and a short ops checklist we’d run through during the demo. If you can confirm preferred format and who needs to be present, I’ll loop in Marissa and Soojin to own the CS/AE prep.

Cheers,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
